senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be bright,] to laugh; to jest, sport.

units: <cite ref="Makkot 24b:1">Macc. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>לכך אני מְצַחֵק</he> (Ms. M. <he>משחק</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) therefore I am glad.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:8">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 21:9">Gen. XXI, 9</cite>) <he>אין מצחק אלא גלוי וכ׳</he> ‘sporting’ alludes to licentiousness, v. <cite ref="R00269"><he>צְחוֹק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Genesis 21:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ועושה … מצחק</he> and pretended to be only jesting; a. e.—V. <cite ref="U00695"><he>שָׂחַק</he></cite>.
